paragraphs.text: I wonder whether Orange is just going to keep buying development cards.
uncertainties: I am unsure whether Orange will keep buying development cards.

paragraphs.text: I think the 4 is definitely the play, though unfortunately I probably have to hit Black there.
uncertainties: Which of the two 4 tiles is intended is not explicit, although only the 4-sheep tile is adjacent to Black.
I am not completely certain that I have to target Black.

paragraphs.text: A 5 is a huge roll for me here.
I see Black's 8 as another huge roll.
I think I should just keep popping here. Largest Army is secure.
uncertainties: The meaning of "keep popping" is unclear.

paragraphs.text: Not having a knight here would be devastating, but I believe Black has one, which would be perfect.
uncertainties: Whether Black has another knight is not publicly known.

paragraphs.text: Red taking Longest Road would be kind of lame, but it would be nice if he did. I worry he'll pull all the victory point cards—that's exactly what we need.
uncertainties: Whether Red will take Longest Road or draw victory point cards is uncertain.

paragraphs.text: I think the play is to block the 9 and see if Black can take Longest Road, which would keep the game going.
uncertainties: Whether Black can take Longest Road is uncertain.
